spans.s: vṛkṣa, nt. (Skt. only m., and so app. Pali rukkha), tree: imāni ca ratnavṛkṣāṇi SP 〔410.12〕 (prose); anyatamad vrkṣam upaśritya Av 〔i.100.16〕.
vṛkṣamūlika, m. (= Pali rukkhamūlika), living, or meditating, at the root of a tree, one of the 12 dhūtaguṇa, q.v.: Mvy 〔1135〕; Dharmas 〔63〕; AsP 〔387.7〕.
